description: Natural Hazards Research Summit 2024: Fluid-Structure Interaction with ALE-SSM: A New Approach to Simulate Structural Responses to Fluid-Induced Loading is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Dimitrios Kalliontzis, University of Houston (uh.edu). Fluid-structure interaction (FSI) phenomena involve coupling between the laws of fluid and structural mechanics. Many of these phenomena are encountered in civil infrastructure, including the interaction of coastal structures with high wind and waves generated by hurricanes. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-tnyd-xn35. Keywords: fluid-structure interaction, two-phase flow, wave impact, wind loading, Navier-Stokes, Force-based element. Published 2024-06-12. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
